examples.text: Alarm and resentment spread through the camp.

examples.text: The clock radio is a friendlier version of the cold alarm by the bedside.

examples.text: The sudden drop in temperature should alarm you into taking precautions.

glosses: To produce a warning of approaching danger or necessary action; to emit a signal intended to rouse a recipient to vigilance or put them on the alert.

examples.text: The loud bang in the hallway seemed to alarm everyone in the building.
